# Modding Horizon

> Horizon is Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 in Rust. A mod is one `.hmod`: content (assets/ and data/), plus an optional Rust crate built native or to mod.wasm against the `mod_api` crate (`horizon-mod-api`).

Prefer a hook or Part method; otherwise use an API `[[inject]]` on native or wasm. Native code needing game internals uses `[[native.mixin]]`; `[[inject]]` has no `access` key; a row that still has one is refused by name.

## Rules

- [Rules for agents](agents.md): the rules in order and the manifest fields.
- [Injections](injections.md): the decision ladder, convertible injections, the hook-request template, ordering.

## Per-concept sources

Edit the individual pages in `concepts/trait-mods/` and `how-to/native-mods/`, not their aggregate pages.
`mdbook build docs/modding` discovers sorted `.md` files there automatically, using the leading
`<!-- chapter: Title -->` metadata for navigation. Adding a concept needs no SUMMARY edit.
Existing heading anchors stay unchanged on the aggregate pages; relative links and compiled-example
includes in a concept page are relative to that page. The build checks their targets and anchors.
The preprocessor needs only Python 3 and runs automatically in local and CI builds.
